## What it is

- Mike Battle's **Echoplex** reached the market in **1959**; the solid-state **EP-3** came in **1970** and was made until 1991 (Wikipedia, "Echoplex").
- Its idea: a loop of tape in a cartridge, with a **record head that slides**, so the delay changes without changing the tape speed (Wikipedia).
- Eddie Van Halen played "Eruption" with an MXR Phase 90 and an Echoplex (Wikipedia).

## How it makes its sound

- The tape passes the record head, then the playback head: the gap between them is the delay. Slide the head away: a longer delay.
- Tape does not move perfectly evenly: slow **wow** and fast **flutter** make the repeats waver in pitch (this model: 0.5 Hz and 7 Hz, the site's values).
- Tape squashes loud signals (saturation) and loses the top and bottom on every pass: warm, worn repeats.
- Repeats feeds the playback back to the record head; near full, it builds up.

## The pedal

The Echoplex EP-3's face, drawn after photos (positions approximate, no logos). Drag a knob (or use the arrow keys), click the footswitch to bypass, then press a ▶ button. The guitar is this site's pickup model (pick one, and its volume, below the buttons); the sound goes through the pedal model, then a clean amp. Nobody has compared it with a real pedal. The picture shows the waveform going in and coming out.

## Guided tour

```{=html}
<div class="pd-step" data-pedal="echoplex" data-set="{&quot;delay&quot;:2,&quot;repeats&quot;:2,&quot;echo&quot;:6}" data-play="riff"><p><b>Short delay.</b> Rockabilly-style slap.</p></div>
<div class="pd-step" data-pedal="echoplex" data-set="{&quot;delay&quot;:6,&quot;repeats&quot;:5,&quot;echo&quot;:6}" data-play="pluck"><p><b>Longer, more repeats.</b> Listen for the waver.</p></div>
<div class="pd-step" data-pedal="echoplex" data-set="{&quot;delay&quot;:9,&quot;repeats&quot;:9,&quot;echo&quot;:8}" data-play="pluck"><p><b>Repeats 9.</b> Building up on the tape.</p></div>
<div class="pd-step" data-pedal="echoplex" data-set="{&quot;delay&quot;:4,&quot;repeats&quot;:3,&quot;echo&quot;:5}" data-play="lead"><p><b>On a lead line.</b></p></div>
```
